description:
## Goal

After fz-kdt.48 establishes one immutable Ty per denotation and pairs activation identity with edge-owned boundary evidence, make activation-row equality exact by construction. One row is the same publication only when its complete correlated value is equal; typed row dominance alone decides strict containment.

## Current defect

Before fz-kdt.48, ActivationInputAlternatives::insert_row uses two authorities for one pair:

- pointwise mutual subtype decides whole-row equivalence;
- Types::row_dominates adds free-variable and callable-shape restrictions.

A template/ground closure pair can therefore be called equivalent but not mutually dominant. Arrival order decides which row, and sometimes how many rows, survive. Row count feeds ACTIVATION_INPUT_ROW_BUDGET and specialization width.

fz-kdt.48 removes callable surface metadata from literal Ty identity and introduces one correlated ActivationInputRow containing exact denotational columns plus aligned boundary-surface evidence. That cut is a prerequisite: fixing the old mixed-arrow representation first would duplicate logic that the denotational model deletes.

## Strategy

1. Land fz-kdt.48.
2. Pin template/ground and same-literal/different-boundary rows in every insertion order through the production activation-input store.
3. Replace the whole-row mutual-subtype equivalence shortcut with exact equality of the complete paired ActivationInputRow.
4. Keep one typed row-dominance relation for strict containment; collapse any now-redundant literal-shape/equivalence machinery.
5. Prove the row antichain, collapse events, semantic answers, work, and artifacts are schedule-independent.
6. Delete stale mixed-arrow tests/comments and update the activation-input documentation.

## Acceptance

- Exact paired row equality is the only identity test.
- Boundary evidence never cross-pairs between rows.
- Typed dominance cannot discard a ground row in favor of an incomparable template row.
- All tested insertion orders yield identical rows, collapse events, activations, executable identities, work, and artifacts.
- No display/canonical string, raw Ty ordering, duplicate surface store, compatibility path, or new scan becomes authoritative.
- Focused RED/GREEN, full library, serial fixture matrix, determinism, formatting, docs, and strict clippy pass.
- A fresh ticket-scoped cold review accepts the final diff before its one commit and close.

## Ordering and scope

fz-kdt.48 blocks this ticket. This ticket then unblocks fz-tfn.14, which specializes the store without changing semantics; fz-tfn.19 later makes publisher reconciliation incremental. Do not absorb either later ticket.
title: Make activation-row equivalence exact after denotational Ty identity
